purpose: Make Stack Lab the required engineering method for Pantheon: canonical decisions, recipes, source components, release evidence, and upgrade boundaries are declared before a release is published.

before_change: bind the affected Stack Lab recipe or create one
identify canonical ADR and contract inputs
declare an independently upgradeable component boundary
before_release: validate canonical documents and recipe paths
test the native app, CLI, menubar, and release builders
produce identical-bundle DMG and PKG artifacts
publish an immutable tag and retain release evidence
after_release: use the exact tagged commit as the next release baseline
record any release failure as a new bounded recipe correction
